from xml.etree import ElementTree

def reading(xml_text, fallback='unknown'):
    root = ElementTree.fromstring(xml_text)
    node = root.find('reading')
    if node:
        return node.text or ''
    return fallback
files.tests/test_behavior.py:
import unittest

class Behavior(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_contract(self):
        from weather import reading
        self.assertEqual(reading('<station><reading>18.5</reading></station>'), '18.5')
        self.assertEqual(reading('<station><reading/></station>', 'offline'), '')
        self.assertEqual(reading('<station/>', 'offline'), 'offline')
        self.assertEqual(reading('<station><group><reading>5</reading></group></station>'), 'unknown')
        self.assertEqual(reading('<station><reading> 0 </reading></station>'), ' 0 ')
        self.assertEqual(reading('<station><reading>ok<unit>C</unit></reading></station>'), 'ok')

    def test_first_direct_reading(self):
        from weather import reading
        self.assertEqual(reading('<station><reading/><reading>19</reading></station>'), '')

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

# weather-xml-reading

reading(xml_text, fallback='unknown') 读取合法 XML 根元素下的第一个直接子元素 reading。存在时返回它的 text（text 为 None 时返回空字符串），只有元素不存在才返回 fallback。保留文本空白；不读取嵌套在其他元素中的 reading。

验证：`python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`。保持公开接口和 tests/ 下的断言；仅使用 Python 3.12 标准库。
